raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely mis-disambiguated “Maria Luisa of Savoy,” shifting focus from the likely intended Maria Luisa Gabriella (Queen of Spain, whose father-in-law is Louis, Grand Dauphin) to Marie Thérèse Louise of Savoy (Princesse de Lamballe), and concluded a Penthièvre duke as the father-in-law. This wrong assumption steered the search down an incorrect lineage and was later compounded by misnaming the father-in-law as “Louis de Bourbon-Toulouse” instead of Louis Jean Marie de Bourbon.
